meta.title: Lowgear Cycle Works | Bike repair in a Hackney railway arch
meta.description: Bike servicing, puncture and brake fixes while you wait, wheel building and steel frame restoration in a railway arch off Mare Street, Hackney.

rationale: A bike workshop under a railway arch should look like its own shop sign, so the whole page sits on one tomato red with black type, heavy condensed uppercase and a yellow accent for the loudest moments. The price index, the giant puncture price and the marquee give couriers what they need at a glance, and a hand-drawn arch with a bike in it shows the actual place. The tone drops from loud to a plain letter from Dami when the page talks about steel frames, the work he loves.

props.before: That old steel frame in your shed is worth

paragraphs: I run Lowgear with Rosa from a railway arch just off Mare Street. Most days it is couriers and commuters who need the bike back before the evening, so punctures and brakes get done while you wait.
The jobs I love are the old steel frames. Bring me the one from your shed or the one you found on a skip, and I will tell you straight whether it is worth saving.
Walk in any time we are open, or book a service ahead if you would rather.
